verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible bottle-left / quote-right structure with readable quote and attribution, but the bottle is cropped at the top edge, the CTA pill is oversized and sits on the cropped peach circle, and the circle no longer backs the product, so the brand motif loses its meaning. B gets the reading order wrong: the CTA and logo sit at the top above the quote. The quote is set small, the bottle shrinks to a minor element, the circle drifts off on its own in the bottom right, and the lower half is mostly dead space.
